topics.title: Repair and adapt equipment
topics.summary: The Mobility Independence Foundation (MIF) promotes open-source mobility designs that users and technicians can repair, adapt and improve. This is an advocacy goal, not a statement that every device already has a legal right to repair.

asks.OH: Support practical Ohio policies that give mobility-equipment users and qualified technicians timely access to parts, repair information and diagnostic tools, with appropriate safeguards. Include users in decisions about repair, adaptation and reuse.
asks.STATE: Support practical policies in {state} that give mobility-equipment users and qualified technicians timely access to parts, repair information and diagnostic tools, with appropriate safeguards. Include users in decisions about repair, adaptation and reuse.
asks.US: Support federal policies that improve timely access to mobility-equipment parts, repair information and diagnostic tools. Include equipment users in decisions about repair, adaptation and reuse.

topics.help: Find repair campaigns and share your repair story.
topics.subject: Please improve mobility equipment repair access

topics.title: Get usable mobility equipment
topics.summary: Medicare Part B covers wheelchairs and scooters when its requirements are met. Power devices require medical necessity, an examination and a prescription. Medicare rules are separate from each state’s Medicaid rules.

asks.OH: Improve Ohio Medicaid access to medically necessary mobility equipment and repairs. Ask for transparent authorization timelines, understandable denial notices, clear appeal routes and a workable plan when essential equipment is unusable.
asks.STATE: Improve Medicaid access in {state} to medically necessary mobility equipment and repairs. Ask for transparent authorization timelines, understandable denial notices, clear appeal routes and a workable plan when essential equipment is unusable.
asks.US: Improve Medicare access to medically necessary mobility equipment and repairs. Ask for transparent authorization timelines, understandable denial notices, clear appeal routes and a workable plan when essential equipment is unusable.

topics.help: Find accessibility and equipment referral resources.
topics.subject: Please improve access to usable mobility equipment

topics.title: Make home accessible
topics.summary: State programs can pay for home changes. In Ohio, for example, Home Care Waiver rules list home modification among covered services. A listing does not establish an individual’s eligibility or approval. Housing accessibility also involves different federal laws, depending on the housing and situation.

asks.OH: Improve access to Ohio home-modification programs, including clear application steps, timely assessments and coordination before discharge. Help people find the right funding route for ramps, entrances and accessible bathrooms.
asks.STATE: Improve access to home-modification programs in {state}, including clear application steps, timely assessments and coordination before discharge. Help people find the right funding route for ramps, entrances and accessible bathrooms.
asks.US: Support accessible housing and home-modification funding that helps people remain at home. Improve coordination across housing and disability programs so people can find an appropriate application route.

topics.help: Find home accessibility programs and preparation checklists.
topics.subject: Please improve home accessibility support

topics.title: Travel and participate
topics.summary: FTA publishes guidance on wheelchair access, paratransit and other ADA transportation duties. It also accepts public-transit discrimination complaints and encourages people to first contact the transit provider.

asks.OH: Support reliable accessible transportation in Ohio, including rural service, usable stops and clear paratransit application information. Ask transit agencies to involve riders with disabilities in planning and publish accessible complaint routes.
asks.STATE: Support reliable accessible transportation in {state}, including rural service, usable stops and clear paratransit application information. Ask transit agencies to involve riders with disabilities in planning and publish accessible complaint routes.
asks.US: Support reliable accessible public transportation and oversight of disability access requirements. Include riders with disabilities in planning and improve access to clear paratransit information and complaint routes.

topics.help: Read the official public-transit complaint process.
topics.subject: Please improve accessible transportation

topics.title: Choose community living
topics.summary: DOJ explains that the ADA’s integration mandate can apply to people in institutions and people at serious risk of institutionalization. Services and eligibility depend on the individual situation; a policy letter is not a service application.

asks.OH: Strengthen Ohio home- and community-based services, personal assistance and transition coordination. Include people with disabilities in planning, improve continuity of support and make program information and participation accessible.
asks.STATE: Strengthen home- and community-based services, personal assistance and transition coordination in {state}. Include people with disabilities in planning, improve continuity of support and make program information and participation accessible.
asks.US: Strengthen home- and community-based services and community integration. Support a stable personal-assistance workforce, continuity of support and meaningful participation by people with disabilities in program decisions.

topics.help: Find care, home support and independent-living referrals.
topics.subject: Please strengthen community living support
